releases.body:
## What's Changed
* todo-command: prefer plugin storage over the message log by @famewolf in https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/pull/14


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1

## What's Changed
* Rebased /todo command + auto-todos onto 0.5.0 (review feedback from #3 addressed) by @famewolf in https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/pull/13

## New Contributors
* @famewolf made their first contribution in https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/pull/13

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/compare/v0.5.0...v0.6.0

## What's Changed
* feat(context): add the update reminders setting via rpc by @aiev in https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/pull/11
* docs: cover update reminders and the release flow by @aiev in https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/pull/12


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/compare/v0.4.4...v0.5.0

## What's Changed
* ci(publish): create the GitHub release on tag pushes by @aiev in https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/pull/9
* feat(tui): rename /todo-sections to /todo-settings by @aiev in https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/pull/10


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/compare/v0.4.3...v0.4.4

## What's Changed
* fix(context): append the todo list at the tail instead of the system prompt by @antomicblitz in https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/pull/5
* perf(context): skip re-injecting an unchanged list on tool continuations by @aiev in https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/pull/8

## New Contributors
* @antomicblitz made their first contribution in https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/pull/5

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aiev/opencode-todolist/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3
